definitions.explanation: A stone slab used for grinding solid ink sticks with water to produce liquid ink for calligraphy or painting.

examples.english: To grind ink on an inkstone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{硯|すずり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{譲|ゆず}り{受|う}けた→譲り受ける：27545_yuzuriukeru⟧。
examples.english: I inherited an inkstone from my grandfather.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧{硯|すずり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Good calligraphy requires a quality inkstone.

notes:
CALLIGRAPHY EQUIPMENT:
One of the ⟦{文房四宝|ぶんぼうしほう}→文房四宝：noentry⟧ (Four Treasures of the Study):
- ⟦{筆|ふで}→筆：03601_fude⟧: brush
- ⟦{墨|すみ}→墨：02155_sumi⟧: ink stick
- {硯|すずり}: inkstone
- ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧: paper

COMMON PATTERNS:
A {硯|すずり} typically has:
- ⟦{陸|おか}→陸：noentry⟧/⟦{丘|おか}→丘：02183_oka⟧: the flat grinding surface
- ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧/⟦{池|いけ}→池：00848_ike⟧: the depression where the liquid ink collects

QUALITY:
Fine inkstones are prized by calligraphers. Famous varieties include:
- ⟦{端渓硯|たんけいけん}→端渓硯：noentry⟧ from China (Duanxi)
- ⟦{雨畑硯|あまはたすずり}→雨畑硯：noentry⟧ from Japan (Yamanashi Prefecture)

USAGE:
A ⟦{墨|すみ}→墨：02155_sumi⟧ (ink stick) is ground in circular motions on the {硯|すずり} with a small amount of water to produce ink of the desired consistency.
